body: Final logic refinements to merge: do not pool representative and adversarial AI tests. Freeze and independently adjudicate representative claims/severity before the run; measure verifier verdict before approval; report false-SUPPORT overall and conditional on ground-truth non-supportable cases, sizing that denominator so zero escapes yields a one-sided 95% upper bound <1%. Keep an enumerated adversarial/security suite requiring zero critical escapes. Add anti-abstention usefulness gates: among ground-truth supportable claims with fetchable sources, provisional pilot thresholds are >=60% eligible yield within 5s and >=80% judge-rated top-3 relevance; these numbers require explicit product-risk approval. Every utterance must terminally recommend or abstain by 5s. Simplify deployment compatibility to `{releaseId, protocolRange, buildId}` handshake, active-session build/SW pinning, and compatible-cohort readiness; no N-1 commitment yet. Add a distinct immutable `displayBindingEpoch` separate from controllerEpoch: locally rendered playback is authoritative only while binding+deck manifest remain valid; rebind/takeover during partition enters RECONCILE_REQUIRED and cannot auto-replay either side.
summary: Final logic refinements for quality and reconciliation
